story: Three sessions of Facundo's (facundo@radiopost.org, KK4ODA). In the first, the link breaks while he is sending his road report; in the second, through the same gateway, he finishes it, and the link breaks while the gateway sends him the photo; in the third, through another gateway, he gets the rest of the photo.
rule: As in session-01.json, for each session. A transmission with `broken` was written whole but received only up to `received_bytes`: the receiver keeps the complete PDUs before the break and drops the partial one. Given what each station holds after a session (`after`), the next session's bytes follow. Pieces carry at most 960 data bytes, an input like the clocks: any piece size is correct (RP-3 §5.4). The messages travel uncompressed, as in session-01.json; a resumed air form must be the same bytes as the one begun (RP-3 §7).

sessions.story: Facundo offers his road report (4 pieces) and asks for the photo, #421. The link breaks in his third piece: the REQUEST never arrives.
sessions.gateway: N1CALL-10, holding the client's credential, online

broken.explain: The link broke 500 bytes into PDU 3 (MSG). The receiver keeps the 2 complete PDUs before it and drops the partial one; nothing after it arrived.

sessions.story: The gateway accepts the report at offset 1920, the bytes it holds, and Facundo sends the rest. The gateway receipts it and sends the photo he asked for; the link breaks in the photo's sixth piece. The report is delivered; the photo is not.
sessions.gateway: N1CALL-10 again, twenty minutes later; it still holds the report's first pieces

broken.explain: The link broke 500 bytes into PDU 7 (MSG). The receiver keeps the 6 complete PDUs before it and drops the partial one; nothing after it arrived.

sessions.story: Facundo lists the photo under `partials` with the 4800 bytes he holds and sends his credential in full (a first visit). The photo counts as asked for: the gateway sends the rest of it after WELCOME, unasked though it is over his `auto` (RP-3 §7), from the post office's air form, the same bytes N1CALL-10 sent.
sessions.gateway: N2CALL-5, a gateway Facundo has not called before, online, the next morning
